topics.title: What is Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)?
topics.summary: Understand what S&OP is, why companies need it, what business problems it solves, and how it connects departments.

topics.title: Purpose and Benefits of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand why companies implement S&OP, the business problems it addresses, its operational and financial benefits, and how it supports cross-functional decisions.

topics.title: Understanding Demand and Supply
topics.summary: Understand demand and supply in business and manufacturing, distinguish customer needs, orders, actual sales and forecasted demand, assess supply capability and constraints, and analyze demand-supply gaps in S&OP.

topics.title: Departments Involved in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand why S&OP requires cross-functional collaboration, the responsibilities and information contributions of Sales, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Planning, Inventory, Finance, Product Management and Executive Leadership, how departments interact, how S&OP resolves conflicts, and how an S&OP Analyst supports aligned business decisions.

topics.title: Planning Horizons in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
topics.summary: Understand short-term, medium-term, and long-term planning; distinguish planning horizon, frequency, and bucket; and connect rolling S&OP plans with strategic direction and operational execution.
